SELECT s.store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line_id, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rcpt_line, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id IN (900, 999) OR f.channel_code='WB'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) d, min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mind, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) maxd, count(l.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE false) z
FROM fact_web_order o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line) l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS sales, 0 AS ret
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, 0, r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(sales)-SUM(ret),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(sales),2) AS before_returns, ROUND(SUM(ret),2) AS returns
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND n.business_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'lines_on_non_dispatched' k, count(*) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_store_lines_without_order', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'zz_test_web_lines', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_pre_migration_dispatch_after', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date<DATE '2025-11-03' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)>=DATE '2025-11-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_returns_total', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_of_web_lines_booked_elsewhere', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store sr ON sr.store_key=r.store_key WHERE sf.store_id=900 AND sr.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_ids', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'skus_with_multiple_current', count(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ret_web AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  GROUP BY 1
),
ret_store AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ret
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store sf ON sf.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND sf.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sold.sku, ROUND(sales,2) sales, ROUND(COALESCE(rw.ret,0),2) ret_web, ROUND(COALESCE(rs.ret,0),2) ret_in_stores,
 ROUND(sales-COALESCE(rw.ret,0),2) net_def, ROUND(sales-COALESCE(rw.ret,0)-COALESCE(rs.ret,0),2) net_incl_store_ret,
 RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales DESC) rk_gross, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales-COALESCE(rw.ret,0) DESC) rk_def, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales-COALESCE(rw.ret,0)-COALESCE(rs.ret,0) DESC) rk_all
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret_web rw USING(sku) LEFT JOIN ret_store rs USING(sku)
QUALIFY rk_gross<=14 OR rk_def<=14 OR rk_all<=14
ORDER BY rk_def
